title: Document work counted in terminal-retention rescan timings
outcome: Readers can distinguish indexed candidate selection from settling-path work in the terminal-retention trace.
acceptance: The test-run rescan documentation identifies that settling an observation can trigger history projection and compaction inside the terminal-retention phase, and explains which idle phase the deterministic candidate counters measure.
The documentation distinguishes origin-present unresolved native registrations, which still remain candidates, from missing-origin diagnostics retained as first-settlement snapshots.
